_format: One object per job in "jobs". Timing is two numbers: "start" (unix seconds - the moment of the first run) and "interval" (unix seconds between runs, omit or 0 to run once). Optional per job: provider, model, temperature, safety (true/false), safety_prompt (must contain {call}). Required: name, prompt, start. Full docs: README.md, or the cron tab in settings.

jobs.name: morning-brief
jobs.prompt: Every morning: check the news for anything worth knowing, and write me two short paragraphs on it. Nothing else.
